name: @bramgeron/pi-draft-response
description: Pi extension for drafting responses on review comments
author: Bram Geron

scripts.smoke: rm -rf .tmp/smoke && mkdir -p .tmp/smoke && aube pack --pack-destination .tmp/smoke >/dev/null && tar -xzf "$(find .tmp/smoke -maxdepth 1 -name '*.tgz' -print -quit)" -C .tmp/smoke && printf '{"id":"smoke","type":"get_commands"}\n' | pi --no-extensions --no-session --offline -e .tmp/smoke/package --mode rpc | grep -q '"name":"draft-response"'
scripts.check: aube run typecheck && aube run test && aube run smoke
